summary.text: Lydia Crafts was a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives for House District 46, Lincoln County, representing Bristol, Damariscotta, Monhegan, Newcastle, and Nobleboro. The House page lists Lydia Crafts as resigned as of Nov 02, 2026.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Lydia Crafts's education as University of Maine Orono (MSW, 2013).
The page lists Lydia Crafts's occupation as Social Worker.
Listed affiliations include Board Member, Maine Health Lincoln Hospital, Chair Sheepscott Community Church, Board Member Portland Seamen's Friends Society.
Lydia Crafts lives in Newcastle and has served 3 sessions in the House, most recently the 132nd Legislature.
